command.name: ACTIVE_SCHEDULE_ENABLE_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued by a node when the schedule state for a target has been altered from any source.

command.name: ACTIVE_SCHEDULE_YEAR_DAY_SCHEDULE_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued by a node when schedule data has been altered from any source.

command.name: ACTIVE_SCHEDULE_DAILY_REPEATING_SCHEDULE_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued by a node when schedule data has been altered from any source.

command.name: BARRIER_OPERATOR_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued by a node when the barrier has finished a transition (e.g. from Open to Close) and reached a final state

command.name: BARRIER_OPERATOR_EVENT_SIGNALING_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when a subsystem state has changed.

command.name: BATTERY_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued by a node in two different cases: periodically to report the current battery level where the frequency is up to the implementation, and when its battery becomes low and the end user needs to reload or replace the battery. The Battery Level field MUST be set to 0xFF to indicate a low battery warning.

command.name: SWITCH_BINARY_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when the binary switch value has changed (and reached a final state)

command.name: CENTRAL_SCENE_NOTIFICATION
command.comment: This command MUST be issued by a node when a user actuated a Scene Notification button/method on the supporting node.

command.name: CENTRAL_SCENE_CONFIGURATION_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued by a node when its Central Scene Configuration has changed.

command.name: CLOCK_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when the clock setting has been modified.

command.name: SWITCH_COLOR_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when a color component level has changed.

command.name: DOOR_LOCK_OPERATION_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued by a node when it has completed a lock/unlock operation initiated locally.

command.name: DOOR_LOCK_CONFIGURATION_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued by when the Door Lock configuration has changed.

command.name: DEVICE_RESET_LOCALLY_NOTIFICATION
command.comment: This command MUST be issued by a node when it has been locally or manually reset to factory default.

command.name: ENTRY_CONTROL_NOTIFICATION
command.comment: This command MUST be issued by a node when a user input has exceeded key cache size or key cache timeout.

command.name: IRRIGATION_SYSTEM_STATUS_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when a system error has occured.

command.name: INDICATOR_REPORT
command.comment: This command SHOULD be issued when an indicator property has changed.

command.name: METER_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued periodically to report the current Meter reading. The sending frequency is up to the implementation. It is RECOMMENDED to implement a minimum reporting interval (for example, every 70 minutes) and send additional reports when a measurement variation occurred A node supporting multiple meter types MUST advertise readings for all of the supported types via the Lifeline Group. Each meter type MAY have a different timing mechanism for reporting its readings.

command.name: SENSOR_MULTILEVEL_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued periodically to report the current Multilevel sensor reading. The sending frequency is up to the implementation. It is RECOMMENDED to implement a minimum reporting interval (for example, every 70 minutes) and send additional reports when a measurement variation occurred. A node supporting multiple sensor types MUST advertise readings for all of the supported types via the Lifeline Group. Each sensor type MAY have a different timing mechanism for reporting its readings.

command.name: SWITCH_MULTILEVEL_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when the multilevel switch value has changed (and reached a final state)

command.name: NOTIFICATION_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued by Push nodes every time a new event is detected or when a state variable has changed state.

command.name: SOUND_SWITCH_CONFIGURATION_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when volume or default tone has changed.

command.name: SOUND_SWITCH_TONE_PLAY_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when a tone has started playing.

command.name: THERMOSTAT_MODE_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when the Thermostat Mode has changed.

command.name: THERMOSTAT_SETBACK_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when the Thermostat Setback has changed.

command.name: THERMOSTAT_SETPOINT_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when the Thermostat Setpoint setting has changed.

command.name: USER_CODE_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when a User Code record is modified.

command.name: USER_CODE_KEYPAD_MODE_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when the Keypad Mode has been modified.

command.name: ADMIN_CODE_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when the Admin Code has been modified.

command.name: EXTENDED_USER_CODE_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when a User Code record with user identifier > 255 has been modified.

command.name: WINDOW_COVERING_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when a Parameter ID has changed value.

command.name: USER_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when a User Credential - User record is modified.

command.name: CREDENTIAL_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when a User Credential - Credential record is modified.

command.name: USER_CREDENTIAL_ASSOCIATION_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when an existing credential is successfully reassigned to another user.

command.name: ADMIN_PIN_CODE_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when the admin code has been modified.

command.name: KEY_LOCKER_ENTRY_REPORT
command.comment: This command MUST be issued when a key locker entry has been modified.
